svg.text: FSDP2 = ZeRO-3 organised by module: the life of ONE group (one fully_shard call) in one microbatch
W = 2 ranks · group = the parameters one fully_shard(m) call claimed (e.g. blocks.3: 12 tensors, 12.03 MiB) · P_g = the group's size
A Where the group's bytes live
every element of a parameter, its gradient and its AdamW moments lives on exactly ONE rank between uses: no replicas
DTensor Shard(0): P_g / W per rank
plain unsharded params on the module
full size, different on each rank
sharded .grad = my slice of the mean
AdamW then updates only this shard, with only this shard's exp_avg / exp_avg_sq
B One rank, one microbatch: hooks, CUDA streams, and what this group holds in memory
all-gather buffer (freed after the NEXT copy-out in fwd)
nosync: these stay; no RS until the last microbatch
Nothing to compare across ranks: a wrong model
cannot diverge. Check gradients and state.
fully_shard keeps chunk r of RANK r's tensor.
its state is sharded with no extra code.
